rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a goal or objective.

example.english: My target this year is to get good results.
example.traditional: 我今年嘅目標係考到好成績。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 nin4 ge3 muk6 biu1 hai6 haau2 dou2 hou2 sing4 zik1

rows.note: Use this specifically for something shot at in target practice or testing.

example.english: The target at the shooting range is already damaged.
example.traditional: 射擊場嗰個靶已經爛咗。
example.jyutping: se6 gik1 coeng4 go2 go3 baa2 ji5 ging1 laan6 zo2

rows.note: Use this for the person or group being targeted in marketing, recruitment, or audience planning.

example.english: The target audience for this ad is young people.
example.traditional: 呢個廣告嘅目標對象係後生仔。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gwong2 gou3 ge3 muk6 biu1 deoi3 zoeng6 hai6 hau6 saang1 zai2

rows.note: Use this specifically for the platform or system that software is intended to run on.

example.english: When we developed this program, we had already decided that the target platform was mobile phones.
example.traditional: 我哋開發呢個程式時，已經定咗目標平台係手機。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 hoi1 faat3 ni1 go3 cing4 sik1 si4 ji5 ging1 ding6 zo2 muk6 biu1 ping4 toi4 hai6 sau2 gei1
